spell.siebenkreis.siebenkreis.guide: Spell of the Seven Heavens. Stacks huge spell circles over the target area, one slow layer at a time, then collapses them into a pillar of light. Each layer adds an effect: 1 Anchor (slows), 2 Binding (pulls inward), 3 Severance (strips buffs), 4 Lens (+30% damage), 5 Echo (second hit), 6 Ward (absorption for you), 7 Crown (shockwave). Interrupted? It fires with the layers already built.
